title: render_machine emits user-absolute paths — nonconforming against the ratified #730 clause

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLASSIFICATION at filing (fix lane; the symmetric duty): defect against the just-ratified Trust-boundaries clause — Diagnostic::render_machine emits file as the absolute path (diagnostics.rs render_machine, file.display()), so a machine form quoted into a tracker record carries the user-absolute path the clause bars. Governed set: executable source. Scope: in the lane (the clause's own scheduled follow-up). Baseline: HEAD at filing (d2c4a3d1). Expected kinds: {assertion-failure} — the pin asserts the machine form renders repo-relative for an in-repo artifact and fails against the current absolute rendering. Fix shape: render_machine takes the repo root and strips the prefix where it applies (out-of-repo paths pass through unchanged — the clause governs record-destined in-repo artifacts); call sites are tests only. Split side: attended act ends at this filing; implementation follows. Validator: security (the clause's validator).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit above): red recorded executed (assertion-failure at the no-absolute-path assert, baseline d2c4a3d1), green at HEAD with the repo-relative rendering; the API takes the repo root, call sites are tests only, out-of-repo passthrough documented. Validator: security at Layer 2's first round (the next cold pass over shared code). Closing.
